title: A run attach dies on one non-JSON answer from the factory's run feed instead of retrying
gloss: attach dies on a bad feed read
description: 2026-10-07 ~15:00 UTC, during a local DNS outage on the operator's Mac: the attached 'ticfac run ex6 --cloud' view exited with 'ticfac watch: the factory's run feed for run_69f8…: not a run event feed: invalid character 'i' looking for beginning of value' — one bad (non-JSON) read ended the attach while the cloud run kept going. A read of the run feed that fails to parse or to connect is transient: keep the last frame, label it stale (as the dashboard does), back off and retry; exit only on a definitive answer (404 run unknown, 401).
acceptance_criteria: a non-JSON or failed run-feed read during attach is retried with backoff and the attach continues; test reproduces the incident's body; make gate
